items.title: Calendar & Time Management
items.description: Coordinate meetings, protect priorities, manage scheduling conflicts and keep calendars organised around what matters most.

items.title: Inbox & Communication Management
items.description: Organise incoming messages, flag priorities, support follow-ups and help keep communication clear and timely.

items.title: Project & Task Coordination
items.description: Break work into trackable tasks, monitor deadlines, organise workflows and keep project details visible.

items.title: Travel & Meeting Coordination
items.description: Organise travel details, meeting information, schedules and supporting documents so plans are easy to follow.

items.title: File Organisation
items.description: Create logical folder structures, maintain shared documents and make information easier for teams to find.

items.title: Data Entry & Reporting
items.description: Maintain accurate records, organise spreadsheet data and turn information into clear, useful reports.
